purpose: Represent large workplace establishments separately from the demographic baseline, including recruitment from abroad.

internationalRecruitmentSharePct.description: Share of job-driven external movers recruited from abroad rather than from elsewhere in Sweden.
internationalRecruitmentSharePct.note: No transferable percentage is assumed from Skelleftea; scenario value must be explicit.

evidence.note: Stegra recruitment is described as drawing workers from Sweden and other parts of the world; around 1500 plant jobs initially and around 2000 longer term.
Stegra explicitly recruits talent globally for the Boden operation.
Observed industrial expansion produced a substantial group of third-country workers; useful as evidence that large northern industrial projects can materially change migration composition.

governance: Skelleftea is evidence for scenario structure, not a direct parameter transfer to Boden.

realizationPct.rationale: Scenario range for how much of the stated job count is realised within the selected phase; not an empirical forecast.

moveSharePct.rationale: Sensitivity range for the share of workers currently outside the FA who relocate rather than commute/rotate; not calibrated from Skelleftea.

personsPerJob.rationale: Sensitivity range separating worker-only effects from accompanying household members; one worker is always modelled separately from companions in worker_household mode.

internationalRecruitmentSharePct.rationale: Explicit sensitivity range for source composition of external movers. It is not transferred from Skelleftea or treated as a forecast.

phaseYears.rationale: Sensitivity range for how quickly the realised employment effect is phased into the population scenario.

bodenReferenceJobs.interpretation: Public project information used only to anchor the job-count scale. Population effects still depend on explicit scenario assumptions below.

low.label: Låg befolkningseffekt
low.interpretation: Lower-bound sensitivity, not a probability statement.

reference.label: Referenskänslighet
reference.interpretation: Middle sensitivity setting for comparison; not the most likely outcome.

high.label: Hög befolkningseffekt
high.interpretation: Upper sensitivity setting, not a probability statement.

presetGovernance: Presets are sensitivity settings, not forecasts or probabilities.
Job count and start year remain explicit user inputs because project timing and realised employment can change.
Observed commuting allocation is preferred when available; manual allocation is fallback only.
International recruitment share changes source composition, not the total external mover count.
Do not retune preset values to force agreement with a known Lulea population outcome.
